name: ue-component-model trigger queries
description: Universal Editor projects (aem-boilerplate-xwalk): should trigger for editor setup (palette, properties panel, filters, models); near misses are code, CSS, tests, dev server and document-based authoring. Two queries are labelled content-modeling to check the pair.

queries.query: We wrote a new `testimonial` block (testimonial.js and CSS are done). Make it show up in the Universal Editor so authors can add it to a section and edit its content.
In the Universal Editor, authors of the `hero` block need a dropdown in the properties panel to choose a light or dark background. Add it.
We're building an image-gallery block for our Universal Editor site. Authors should be able to add any number of images, each with alt text. Set up everything the editor needs.
We need tabs in the Universal Editor, where each tab holds a cards block. How do I define that in the project's component definitions?
I added a `teaser` entry in a block's JSON file and committed, but it doesn't show in the Universal Editor's add menu on the page.
I edited component-models.json at the repo root for the hero block, committed, and my change was gone afterwards. What's going on?
We're adding a `promo-banner` block (image, headline, short text, one button) and our authors work in Universal Editor. Design the block so it's easy for them to use, then build it.
We're adding a `promo-banner` block (image, headline, short text, one button) and our authors work in Universal Editor. Design the block so it's easy for them to use, then build it.
On our other site, authors write pages in Google Docs. Design what authors type for a new `testimonial` block: quote, name, role, photo.
The cards block looks broken on tablet: the third card wraps under the first two and the images stretch. Fix the CSS.
Write the decorate function for the `cards` block so each row becomes a list item with a linked image and a heading.
`aem up` dies immediately with EADDRINUSE and I don't know what is on the port. How do I fix it?
Write Playwright tests for the hero block that check the heading and the CTA link render and that the image has an alt attribute.
Please review PR #214 on our repo. Someone changed the columns block's JS; check for bugs and accessibility problems.
On our Google Docs site, design what authors type for a new `testimonial` block: quote, name, role, photo.
